voices.scientist-1: Older male, thick Russian accent, manic and gleeful — mad-scientist energy
voices.scientist-2: Younger male, nasal and eager, always impressed — the yes-man of the pair
voices.both-in-unison: Both voices shouted together in unison, triumphant

subs.text: Comrade, our Democratic Socialists finally cracked it! Free stuff for everyone!
Genius. How do we pay for it?
We tax the rich, then the middle class, then you!
